DSDS.Menu.Name: Death Screen Settings
DSDS.Menu.Label: Open settings
DSDS.Menu.Hint: Images, sound and timings of the death screen.
DSDS.Settings.Title: Dark Souls Death Screen — Settings
DSDS.Settings.AutoEnableHint: On save, the death screen is enabled for every player-owned character, and for newly created player characters.
DSDS.Settings.DeathConditionFinal: On final death (failed death saves or Dead status)
DSDS.Settings.DeathConditionHint: In final death mode, the screen triggers after 3 failed death saves (or when the Dead status is applied). For actors and systems without death saves, it triggers at 0 HP.
DSDS.Settings.NoImages: The list is empty. Add at least one image.
DSDS.Settings.OffsetHint: Positive: sound starts after the image, negative: before. 0: simultaneous.
DSDS.Settings.NoImageWarn: No image to show. Add one in the settings.
DSDS.Settings.OneshotHint: Triggers if a character at full HP is dropped to 0 HP in a single hit, or if excess damage past 0 HP equals or exceeds max HP (instant death in D&D 5e).
DSDS.Settings.OneshotImagePlaceholder: Leave empty to use default image
DSDS.Settings.OneshotSoundPlaceholder: Leave empty to use default sound
